question: For a woman under 35, how long do couples usually try to conceive before healthcare providers look into infertility?
explanation: You've got this! Doctors use 12 months as the benchmark for younger women because about 85% of couples successfully conceive within that first year. Keep up the great studying! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h1)

question: Why is the waiting time before checking for infertility shortened to just 6 months for women aged 35 and older?

options.A: The uterus shrinks and cannot hold a pregnancy safely
options.B: Older women have more chronic infections in the pelvis
options.C: Hormone levels drop to zero immediately after thirty-five
options.D: Ovarian reserve and egg quality decline rapidly after this age

explanation: Spot on! A woman's biological clock ticks a bit faster in her mid-thirties, so catching any issues early helps make treatments much more successful. You're learning fast! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h1)

question: What is the main hormonal problem behind hypothalamic amenorrhea?

options.D: Total absence of circulating insulin in the blood

explanation: Well done! Physical or emotional stress can throw off the hypothalamus, putting a pause on the hormone pulses needed to keep the monthly cycle going. You are mastering the basics! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h2)

question: A 25-year-old patient comes in with weight gain, facial hair growth, and no periods for 8 months. Which condition fits best?
explanation: Exactly right! The classic trio of high male hormone signs, irregular cycles, and weight shifts points straight to polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS). You're doing brilliant clinical thinking! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h2)

question: Which common infection is most often responsible for scarring the fallopian tubes and causing female infertility?
explanation: You nailed it! Sexually transmitted infections like chlamydia can cause silent infections that quietly damage the delicate lining of the tubes. Great job staying sharp on clinical facts! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h3)

question: How does endometriosis most commonly lead to infertility in women?

options.A: By causing pelvic adhesions and scarring that block the fallopian tubes
options.B: By lowering body temperature so much that embryos cannot implant
options.C: By destroying the pituitary gland and stopping all hormone production
options.D: By making the cervical mucus permanently hostile to male sperm cells

explanation: Spot on! Endometrial patches outside the womb cause ongoing inflammation and scar tissue, which can twist or block the tubes and ovaries. Keep crushing these questions! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h3)

question: Which type of uterine fibroid is most likely to cause trouble with a fertilized egg trying to implant?
explanation: Brilliant! Submucosal fibroids grow right inside the main cavity of the womb, messing directly with the inner lining where pregnancy needs to begin. You've got this! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h4)

question: What is Asherman syndrome?

options.A: The complete absence of the ovaries since birth
options.B: An abnormal widening of the cervical canal due to infection
options.C: The formation of scar tissue inside the uterine cavity
options.D: A benign growth of muscle tissue on the outer wall of the uterus

explanation: Correct! Asherman syndrome happens when scar tissue forms inside the womb—often after past surgeries or procedures—causing the walls to stick together. Learning everyday clinical terms like this makes you a stronger nurse! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h4)

question: How does cigarette smoking harm a woman's chances of getting pregnant?

options.A: It accelerates the loss of eggs from the ovaries
options.B: It causes the uterine muscles to atrophy completely
options.C: It permanently seals the cervical opening shut
options.D: It stops the pituitary gland from making growth hormone

explanation: You got it! Harmful toxins in cigarette smoke damage ovarian follicles, causing them to burn out quicker than normal. Every question you practice builds your nursing intuition! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h5)

question: Why can severe obesity lead to problems with ovulation in women?

options.A: Excess weight physically crushes the fallopian tubes flat
options.B: Fat tissue alters hormone levels and causes insulin resistance
options.C: High body fat stops the liver from filtering normal vitamins
options.D: Obesity causes the uterus to double in physical size

explanation: Spot on! Excess adipose tissue shifts hormone balances and sparks insulin resistance, throwing off the delicate signals needed for regular ovulation. Fantastic reasoning! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h5)

question: What is the main goal of doing a hysterosalpingography test during an infertility workup?

options.A: To count the total number of immature eggs remaining in the ovaries
options.B: To check the thyroid gland for signs of overactivity
options.C: To visualize the uterine cavity and check if fallopian tubes are open
options.D: To measure the exact daily progesterone levels in the blood

explanation: Awesome job! During this test, dye is put through the cervix so x-rays can show if the fluid flows nicely through the tubes. You're building solid practical knowledge! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h6)

question: A patient undergoing fertility testing shares that she feels deeply sad and worthless. What is the best first thing for a nurse to do?

options.A: Assure her that medical treatments work on the first try for almost everyone
options.B: Tell her that adoption is a very easy alternative to consider right away
options.C: Advise her to stop thinking about pregnancy so her hormones will normalize
options.D: Acknowledge her emotional pain and offer a supportive, non-judgmental space to talk

explanation: You nailed it! Validating her deep emotional pain builds essential trust and shows true compassionate nursing care. Keep up the wonderful work! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T21#GNS312_U1_T21_h6)
